notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[h1] Changes: [/h1]

[list]
[*]Some adjustments have been made to the collision boxes of the red coins, trying to avoid physics bugs.
[*]Added a significant improvement in performance for more modest PCs, replacing some static lights in realtime with other cooked ones and other adjustments.
[/list]

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1]Update Changes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Added new models and improved the old ones (remodeled).
[*]Better textures, light effects and particles.
[*]New sound effects and music.
[*]Renewed interface.
[*]Added a menu to tweak stuff.
[*]Added new mysterious locations and secrets.
[*]Added new achievements.
[*]Fixed bugs (physics, hitboxes, performance, etc).
[*]Now it's much colder...
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this new update.
Thank you for playing.
